She claims she is focusing with me with her ears and understands perfectly. I always tell her that it annoys me when she does that because I feel like she isn't focusing. I lost my temper and left before I can finish what I wanted to show her. She apologized and I didn't forgive her. I am planning to forgive her once I post this text, but I just wanted to know if I was the A-hole.
